de: Besuchen Sie das Grab des Heiligen Patrick an der Down Cathedral; es ist durch einen großen Granitfelsen markiert.
Kommen Sie am dritten Samstag im Monat für den Artisan Market am Saint Patrick Square.
Erkunden Sie das Down County Museum, das in einem ehemaligen Gefängnis aus dem 18. Jahrhundert untergebracht ist.
Wandern Sie zum Slieve Patrick hinauf, um eine Statue des Heiligen und einen Panoramablick über das Umland zu sehen.
Besuchen Sie die Saul Church außerhalb des Zentrums, wo der Heilige Patrick seine erste Kirche in einer Scheune errichtet haben soll.
hu: Keresd meg Szent Patrik sírját a Down-székesegyháznál, amit egy hatalmas gránitszikla jelöl!
Ha teheted, a hónap harmadik szombatján gyere, ekkor tartják a kézműves piacot a Saint Patrick Square-en.
Nézz körül a Down megyei múzeumban, ami egy 18. századi börtön épületében kapott helyet.
Sétálj fel a Slieve Patrick dombra a szoborhoz, onnan látni az egész környéket!
Látogass el a város melletti Saul Church-höz, ahol Szent Patrik állítólag az első templomát alapította egy pajtában!
ro: Vizitați mormântul Sfântului Patrick de la Catedrala Down, marcat de un bolovan uriaș de granit.
Vizitați piața artizanală din Saint Patrick Square, organizată în a treia sâmbătă a fiecărei luni.
Explorați Muzeul Județean Down, găzduit într-o fostă închisoare din secolul al XVIII-lea.
Urcați pe Slieve Patrick pentru a vedea statuia sfântului și o panoramă superbă asupra regiunii.
Vizitați Biserica Saul din afara centrului, unde se spune că Sfântul Patrick și-a întemeiat prima biserică într-un hambar.
en: Visit St. Patrick’s Grave at Down Cathedral, marked by a massive granite boulder in the churchyard.
Visit on the third Saturday of the month to enjoy the local Artisan Market at Saint Patrick Square.
Explore the Down County Museum, uniquely housed in a restored 18th-century gaol (jail).
Walk up Slieve Patrick to see the tall statue of the saint and enjoy panoramic views over the area.
Visit Saul Church just outside the town, known as the site where Saint Patrick is said to have established his first church in a barn.

de.name: Finnebrogue Woods Fodder

hu.name: Denvir’s Coaching Inn

hu.name: Finnebrogue Woods Fodder
hu.tip: Próbáld ki a helyi marhából készült burgereiket és a kézműves sajtjaikat az erdei környezetben!

hu.name: Oakley Fayre
hu.tip: Itt eheted a legjobb Ulster Fry-t (hagyományos bőséges reggeli) és házi süteményeket.

ro.name: Denvir’s Coaching Inn

ro.name: Finnebrogue Woods Fodder

ro.name: Oakley Fayre

en.name: Denvir’s Coaching Inn

en.name: Finnebrogue Woods Fodder

en.name: Oakley Fayre
en.tip: The go-to spot for a proper 'Ulster Fry' breakfast and a massive selection of home-baked treats.

de.name: Saint Patrick Square Markt

ro.name: Buticurile de pe Market Street

en.name: Saint Patrick Square Market

en.name: Market Street Boutiques

hu.name: Inch Abbey romok
